Did you know?
  • Chris and her family drive out of the city only once a month.
  • Grandma waits for them outside the house every time.
  • The children hate one thing only — the moment they have to leave.

📖Read the text اقرأ النص

صفحة 19 من الكتاب — الأطفال يلعبون فى الحقول
صفحة 20 من الكتاب — الجدة تُعِدّ الطعام

Read

00:00 / 00:00 اسحب على الشريط للتنقّل · اضغط أى كلمة فى النص للانتقال إليها

Part 1 — The long drive to the country I’m Chris. I love spending the weekend at my grandparent’s house. Once a month, we travel to see them. It is very special because we live in a large city and my grandparents live out in the country. It is a very long drive to their house, but it is a lot of fun. We are always very excited to leave. My brothers and I wait for my parents to wake up on Saturday morning. We all have breakfast together, usually some pancakes or waffles, and then pack the car. We pack some snacks because of the long trip. My parents always play games with us in the car. After we drive through the crammed and dusty city, the sight of the large fields and farms is always shocking. My grandparents live in a patch of forest in between two mansions. The road near their house is made of dirt and is very rough and bumpy. The house is a bit old but warm and cosy.

Read

00:00 / 00:00 اسحب على الشريط للتنقّل · اضغط أى كلمة فى النص للانتقال إليها

Part 2 — A day at grandma’s house My grandma always waits outside for us. After we stop the car, my sisters and I cannot wait to get into the house because we know our granny always greets us with her delicious, homemade cookies, pies and cakes. However, before we are allowed to eat our dessert, we have to hug and kiss our grandfather. We love him, but we cannot stop laughing when he kisses us because his beard tickles our faces. After lunch, we run out into the forest to play. We spend all day getting dirty, climbing trees, and splashing through the creek. When it starts to get dark, it is time to come in for dinner. Our dinners are always full of laughter and most importantly; granny’s delicious food. After dinner, we play board games inside until it is time to leave. It is always a sad time to leave my grandparent’s house, but I know that we will visit them again soon.

❓Answer the following questions أجب عن الأسئلة الآتية

صفحة 20 من الكتاب — الجسر المغطّى قرب بيت الأجداد
1- How often does Chris visit her grandparents?
اعرض الإجابة
Once a month.
2- What does the family have for breakfast on Saturdays?
اعرض الإجابة
They usually have pancakes or waffles.
3- Describe the road to grandma’s house.
اعرض الإجابة
It is made of dirt and it is very rough and bumpy.
4- What is the difference between the city and where grandma lives?
اعرض الإجابة
The city is large, crammed and dusty, while the grandparents live in the country among large fields, farms and a patch of forest.
5- What does grandma prepare for the kids?
اعرض الإجابة
She greets them with delicious homemade cookies, pies and cakes, and cooks their dinner.
6- How do the kids spend the weekend at grandma’s house?
اعرض الإجابة
They hug their grandfather, run into the forest, climb trees, get dirty, splash through the creek, have dinner and play board games.

⚖️Write (True) or (False) صح أم خطأ مع التصحيح

Correct the false statements.

1- Chris and her grandparents live in the same neighbourhood.
اعرض الإجابة
False — Chris lives in a large city while her grandparents live out in the country — it is a very long drive.
2- The kids always have so much fun at their grandparents’.
اعرض الإجابة
True
3- The kids love grandma’s waffles and pancakes.
اعرض الإجابة
False — They eat pancakes or waffles at home before they leave; grandma is loved for her cookies, pies and cakes.
4- Grandma lives in a big mansion.
اعرض الإجابة
False — Her house is a bit old but warm and cosy; it lies in a patch of forest between two mansions.
5- The kids are always happy to go back to the city.
اعرض الإجابة
False — It is always a sad time for them to leave their grandparents’ house.

📝Complete the paragraph أكمل الفقرة الآتية

Use words from the text to complete the paragraph below.

Spending some time with my granny is always very ……………… . She is the kindest person on Earth. I ……………… her as much as I love my parents. Granny cooks ……………… food. She knows my favourite dishes and ……………… . She always prepares ……………… and ……………… . In the evening, we gather for ……………… and then we play ……………… and watch films.

اعرض الإجابة
Spending some time with my granny is always very special . She is the kindest person on Earth. I love her as much as I love my parents. Granny cooks delicious food. She knows my favourite dishes and desserts . She always prepares homemade cookies and pies and cakes . In the evening, we gather for dinner and then we play board games and watch films.

❓Think and discuss فكّر وناقش

1- Compare the kids’ feelings on the way to their grandparents’ house to their feelings on their way back home.
اعرض الإجابة
On the way there they are always very excited and cannot wait to arrive — they even play games in the car. On the way back they are sad, because they have to leave the house, the forest and their granny’s food behind.
2- If you were to spend the weekend at some place away from home, where would that be? Why?
اعرض الإجابة
I would spend it in a small village by the sea, because it is quiet and far from the crowded, noisy city, and I could swim, walk and spend the whole day with my family instead of my phone.
